left.raw_text: - Men or women of any race or ethnicity aged 18 or older
- No symptoms of ALS or fronto-temporal dementia at enrollment
- Have a first degree relative who had an ALS-spectrum diagnosis with a confirmed ALS-spectrum gene mutation;

right.raw_text: or already have had genetic testing and have tested positive for an ALS-spectrum gene mutation.

left.raw_text: - Willing to undergo genetic testing with option of whether or not to learn results
- Willing to travel to Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC) every 6-24 months for study procedures

right.raw_text: - Capable of providing informed consent and following study procedures, or has a legally authorized representative who is able to consent for the subject.
